focus: Unread releases v4.0.0.1, .8, .9, .10, .11 against the CLI + deep-loop cluster

graphEvents.label: Do hub packets route from their own ROUTER.md and follow parent-hub canon
20 of 27 deep-loop scripts reject no unknown options; the mandatory append gateway accepts any flag
All 9 hub packets carry ROUTER.md and every SKILL.md references it
Hub ROUTER.md version lags SKILL.md by design, giving one field name two meanings
Hub mode folders, registry modes, router signals and aliases align with zero orphans

label: v4.0.0.8 claims the deep-loop scripts refuse unknown options and keep their JSON error with exit 3, but only 7 of 27 runtime scripts have any unknown-option handling; append-mode-event.cjs, the gateway every deep-loop iteration is required to call, accepts any --flag by assignment with no allowlist, so the highest-consequence typo in the protocol is silently absorbed instead of named.

The unknown-option gap is a missing shared primitive: 20 scripts hand-roll process.argv slicing, so a shared parseArgs(argv,{allowed}) helper in runtime/lib emitting the documented JSON error plus exit 3 would close the class for every future script rather than re-applying the v4.0.0.8 sweep 27 times by hand.

Hub ROUTER.md carries its own version and is deliberately excluded from the doctor's comparison with SKILL.md, so version: means current release in description.json, hub-router.json and mode-registry.json but last-edit release in ROUTER.md; the lag is 1.7.11.0 vs 1.8.0.0 on cli-external-orchestration and 0.8.5.0 vs 0.8.9.0 on cli-classifier, with nothing on the page scoping the number to the document.

Hub canon routing rule holds structurally: 9 of 9 packets (7 cli modes plus both hub roots) ship a ROUTER.md and every SKILL.md references it, 1 to 13 times each, so the per-packet ROUTER.md routing requirement is satisfied; only parent-hub canon under package_skill.py --strict remains unproven.
verify: for d in .skilled/skills/cli-external-orchestration/*/; do ls $d/ROUTER.md; grep -c ROUTER.md $d/SKILL.md; done

label: v4.0.0.9 hub-integrity claims verified clean on both cli hubs: 7 mode folders with SKILL.md equal 7 modes[] entries equal 7 routerSignals keys with zero orphans either way, every aliases[] entry of all 7 modes appears verbatim in a vocabularyClasses keyword list, SKILL.md/description.json/hub-router.json/mode-registry.json versions agree, and all 85 changelog entries across the three audited skills carry a version: key.
verify: node -e 'compare mode-registry modes[] to hub-router routerSignals to disk folders'; grep -L '^version:' .skilled/skills/*/changelog/*.md

label: v4.0.0.10 and v4.0.0.11 contain no claim naming any of the four cluster paths; both are verified-empty for this cluster rather than unread.

No stale gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, mimo-v2.5, mimo-v2.6-pro-ultraspeed or claude-opus-5-4 ids remain on a live dispatch surface in the cluster; the only hits are frozen benchmark evidence under cli-external-orchestration/benchmark/reports/compiled-routing/2026-07-21--*, which record past dispatches and should stay as history.

The carried-forward question about a validator comparing ROUTER.md's version with SKILL.md's is answered negatively and by design: v4.0.0.9 states the doctor compares only description.json, hub-router.json and mode-registry.json with SKILL.md, and /create:changelog no longer writes the release version into ROUTER.md.
